name: More Trim Materials
summary: Trim your armor with coal, obsidian, echo shards, slime and more, each material with a color of its own.
logoPrompt: A single iron chestplate decorated with a bright violet and teal armor trim pattern, centred, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Eight new colors for your armor trims.
bullets: On worn armor and its icon

description: **More Trim Materials lets the smithing table trim armor with eight more items, each giving the trim a color of its own.**
- New trim materials: coal, obsidian, echo shard, slime ball, breeze rod, nether brick, popped chorus fruit and prismarine shard.
- Each has its own palette, from deep obsidian violet to pale breeze blue.
- Works with every vanilla trim pattern on all armor except copper.
- Worn armor and its icon show the trim; the tooltip names the material.

Put the zip into the `datapacks` folder of your world and into your `resourcepacks` folder, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs. At a smithing table, add a trim template, the armor and one of the new items.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1, 1.21.2 and 26.3.
- On a server the zip goes into the world's `datapacks` folder; players add it as a resource pack to see the colors.
- Keep the data pack in a world once armor carries a new trim: without it the game cannot read that armor.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or want another material? Leave a comment.
